demonstrates: Built a fixed-order arithmetic path that makes one model produce byte-identical output across nine NVIDIA GPUs, five architecture generations, two operating systems and two CUDA toolchains -- a property the vendor stack does not provide and PyTorch's determinism settings do not address.
